TextEncoder: WHATWG `TextEncoder`. Encodes strings to UTF-8 bytes.
TextEncoder.encode: Encode `input` as UTF-8 and return the result as a `Buffer`.
TextEncoder.encodeInto: Encode `input` as UTF-8 into `destination`. Returns the number of UTF-16 units of `input` read and the number of bytes written.
TextDecoder: WHATWG `TextDecoder`. Decodes bytes to strings using the encoding given at construction.
TextDecoder.constructor: Create a `TextDecoder` for `label`. Only `'utf-8'` (and its aliases) is supported; any other label throws.
TextDecoder.decode: Decode `input` to a string. If `options.stream` is `true`, buffers any incomplete trailing sequence for the next call instead of including it in the result.
TextDecoder.encoding: The encoding this decoder was constructed with, always `'utf-8'`.
TextEncoderConstructor: The type of the `TextEncoder` class, used to type the global `TextEncoder` constructor.
TextDecoderConstructor: The type of the `TextDecoder` class, used to type the global `TextDecoder` constructor.
EncodingError: An error thrown by this module, carrying a `code` identifying the failure.
EncodingError.code: The error code identifying the failure.
EncodingError.INVALID_LABEL: The label passed to `TextDecoder` is not a valid encoding.
